label: Printful sync runs
description: Cursor and request budget for the catalog sync. A run stops at its budget and the next cron tick resumes from the stored offset rather than restarting.

state.description: paused means the budget ran out mid-catalog and the next tick should resume this run

product_offset.description: Offset into /v2/catalog-products that the next run resumes from

requests_used.description: Printful calls spent so far in this run

request_budget.description: Hard cap on Printful calls per run. Catalog sync shares the 120-per-minute limit with checkout quotes, so it must leave headroom

items_synced.description: Catalog item rows written by this run
